subject: dsa
title: K Closest Points to Origin
summary: Keep a max-heap of size k keyed by squared distance. The farthest kept point sits at the root, so a closer arrival can evict it in one step.
problem: Find the k = 2 points closest to the origin. Keep a max-heap of size k keyed by squared distance, so the farthest kept point is the root and is easy to evict.

steps.caption: Keep the k = 2 closest using a max-heap by squared distance. The root is the farthest kept point.
After point (1,3) with distance 10 and (-2,2) with distance 8, the heap is 10, 8 with root 10.
Add (5,8) with distance 89. It is bigger than the root 10, so it is farther than both kept points. Skip it.
Add (0,1) with distance 1. It is smaller than the root 10, so it is closer. Pop 10 and push 1.
The heap holds distances 8 and 1, the points (-2,2) and (0,1).
